verse.verse_1: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing worth mentioning?
verse.verse_2: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid so that We might try him; We gave him hearing and sight;
verse.verse_3: We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.
verse.verse_4: [Now,] behold, for those who deny the truth, We have prepared chains, iron collars and a blazing fire, but
verse.verse_5: the righteous shall drink from a cup mixed with the coolness of kafur,
verse.verse_6: a spring from which God's servants will drink, making it gush forth in branches.
verse.verse_7: They keep their vows and fear a day the woe of which will spread far and wide;
verse.verse_8: they give food, despite their love for it, to the poor and orphans and captives,
verse.verse_9: saying, "We feed you for the sake of God alone, we seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
verse.verse_10: Truly, we fear from our Lord a woefully grim Day."
verse.verse_11: Therefore, God will ward off from them the woes of that Day, and make them find brightness and joy,
verse.verse_12: and their reward for being patient will be a Garden and silk [clothing].
verse.verse_13: Reclining upon couches, they will find therein neither the heat of the sun nor bitter, biting cold,
verse.verse_14: the shading branches of trees will come down low over them, and their clusters of fruit, will hang down where they are the easiest to reach.
verse.verse_15: Vessels of silver and goblets of pure crystal will be passed round among them
verse.verse_16: and gleaming silver goblets which have been filled to the exact measure,
verse.verse_17: and they will be given a cup to drink flavoured with ginger,
verse.verse_18: from a flowing spring called Salsabil.
verse.verse_19: They will be attended by youths who will not age -- when you see them you will think them to be like sprinkled pearls --
verse.verse_20: wherever you look, you will see bliss and a great kingdom:
verse.verse_21: they will wear green garments of fine silk and rich brocade. They will be adorned with silver bracelets. And their Lord will give them a pure drink.
verse.verse_22: This is your reward. Your endeavour is fully acknowledged.
verse.verse_23: Truly, it is We who have revealed to you the Quran, a gradual revelation.
verse.verse_24: So wait patiently for the command of your Lord, and do not yield to anyone among them who is sinful or ungrateful;
verse.verse_25: and glorify your Lord morning and evening;
verse.verse_26: and during the night prostrate ourself before Him, and extol His glory for a long part of the night.
verse.verse_27: Those people [who are unmindful of God] aspire for immediate gains, and put behind them a Heavy Day.
verse.verse_28: It was We who created them and made their constitution strong, but if We wish we can replace them with others like them.
verse.verse_29: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the right path to his Lord.
verse.verse_30: But you cannot will it unless God wills [to show you that way] -- God is indeed all-knowing and wise --
verse.verse_31: He admits whoever He will into His grace and has prepared a painful punishment for the evil doers.
